paragraphs.prompt: Học trực tuyến có lợi cho sinh viên không?

s.t: One major advantage of online learning is that it saves students a lot of time.
Since students do not need to travel to class, they can use that time to study or rest.
For example, a student who lives an hour away from the university can save two hours every day.
Therefore, online learning can help students manage their time more effectively.

paragraphs.prompt: Thành phố có nên khuyến khích người dân đi xe đạp?

s.t: Encouraging people to cycle would make cities much cleaner.
Bicycles do not produce any exhaust fumes, unlike cars and motorbikes.
In Copenhagen, where almost half of all trips to work are made by bike, the air is noticeably cleaner than in many other capitals.
For this reason, governments should build more safe bike lanes.

paragraphs.prompt: Điện thoại thông minh ảnh hưởng thế nào đến gia đình?

s.t: Smartphones can reduce the time that family members spend talking to each other.
When people check their phones during meals, they pay less attention to the people around them.
Many parents say that their teenage children answer messages from friends even at the dinner table.
As a result, families may become less close if phone use is not controlled.

paragraphs.prompt: Vì sao mọi người nên tập thể dục thường xuyên?

s.t: Regular exercise is one of the best ways to stay healthy.
It strengthens the heart and helps people control their weight.
Doctors recommend just thirty minutes of walking a day to lower the risk of heart disease.
Clearly, a small amount of daily exercise can make a big difference to our health.

paragraphs.prompt: Vì sao giới trẻ chuyển lên thành phố?

s.t: The main reason why young people move to cities is to find better jobs.
Big cities have more companies, so there are more opportunities and higher salaries.
In Vietnam, thousands of graduates move to Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City every year to start their careers.
Unless rural areas create more jobs, this trend is likely to continue.

paragraphs.prompt: Trẻ em có nên đọc sách giấy mỗi ngày?

s.t: Reading paper books every day helps children develop their language skills.
When children read, they meet new words and learn how sentences are built.
A child who reads for twenty minutes a day sees more than a million words in a year.
Parents should therefore make reading a daily habit for their children.

paragraphs.prompt: Vì sao đồ ăn nhanh phổ biến?

s.t: Fast food is popular mainly because it is cheap and convenient.
People who work long hours often do not have time to cook healthy meals.
For instance, many office workers buy a burger or a sandwich and eat it at their desks.
This explains why fast food restaurants are always busy at lunchtime.

paragraphs.prompt: Du lịch mang lại lợi ích gì cho người dân địa phương?

s.t: Tourism can bring many benefits to local communities.
Tourists spend money on hotels, food and souvenirs, which creates jobs for local people.
In Hoi An, many families earn their living by running small restaurants and tailor shops for visitors.
Overall, tourism can improve the standard of living in popular destinations.

paragraphs.prompt: Người cao tuổi có nên học dùng công nghệ?

s.t: Learning to use technology can make elderly people's lives easier.
With a smartphone, they can contact their families, pay bills and see a doctor online.
My grandmother now video-calls her grandchildren in Australia every weekend.
It is therefore worth helping older people to learn these skills.

paragraphs.prompt: Vì sao nên tự nấu ăn ở nhà?

s.t: Cooking at home is usually healthier than eating out.
People who cook for themselves can choose fresh ingredients and use less salt, sugar and oil.
A home-made bowl of soup, for example, often has half the salt of a restaurant one.
Learning to cook is therefore a simple way to improve our diet.

paragraphs.prompt: Làm việc ở nhà có làm tăng năng suất?

s.t: Working from home may increase productivity for some types of jobs.
Without the noise and interruptions of an office, employees can often concentrate better on tasks that need deep thinking.
A software developer, for instance, may finish more code in a quiet room at home than in a busy open-plan office.
However, this benefit seems to depend largely on the type of work and the person's self-discipline.

paragraphs.prompt: Trẻ em xem màn hình quá nhiều có hại không?

s.t: Spending too much time on screens can have a negative effect on children's health.
Children who watch videos for hours tend to sit still and may get less physical exercise.
According to some doctors, screen time is one of the reasons why more children are overweight today.
It is therefore advisable for parents to set clear limits on daily screen use.

paragraphs.prompt: Có nên đánh thuế cao xe hơi cá nhân?

s.t: Higher taxes on private cars could be an effective way to reduce air pollution.
If driving becomes more expensive, many people are likely to switch to buses, trains or bicycles.
When London introduced a charge for driving into the city centre, traffic in that area fell considerably.
Such a policy, however, should go together with better public transport so that people have real alternatives.

paragraphs.prompt: Có phải ai cũng nên học đại học?

s.t: A university degree is not necessarily the best path for every young person.
Many well-paid jobs, such as electricians or chefs, require practical training rather than academic study.
In Germany, a large number of school leavers choose vocational programmes and find stable jobs quickly.
Young people should therefore be encouraged to consider all their options, not only university.

paragraphs.prompt: Mua sắm online ảnh hưởng gì đến cửa hàng nhỏ?

s.t: The growth of online shopping appears to be putting pressure on small local shops.
Online sellers can often offer lower prices because they do not have to pay rent for a shop on a busy street.
In many towns, small bookshops have closed since customers started buying books on the internet.
To survive, local shops may need to offer something that websites cannot, such as personal service.

paragraphs.prompt: Dân số già hoá đặt ra thách thức gì?

s.t: An ageing population is likely to put a heavy burden on healthcare systems.
Older people generally need more medical care, and the cost of treating long-term illnesses is high.
In Japan, where more than a quarter of the population is over sixty-five, health spending has risen steadily for decades.
Governments will therefore need to plan carefully to keep healthcare affordable.

paragraphs.prompt: Đọc tin trên mạng xã hội có đáng tin?

s.t: News on social media is not always reliable.
Anyone can post information online, and false stories often spread faster than true ones because they are more shocking.
During health crises, for example, fake cures have been shared millions of times before experts could correct them.
Readers should therefore check important news with trusted sources before believing or sharing it.

paragraphs.prompt: Thành phố có cần thêm không gian xanh?

s.t: Green spaces play an important role in making cities pleasant places to live.
Parks give residents a place to exercise and relax, which can reduce stress.
Research suggests that people who live near a park report higher levels of happiness than those who do not.
City planners should therefore protect existing parks and create new ones where possible.

paragraphs.topic: Giải trí · trò chơi điện tử
paragraphs.prompt: Trò chơi điện tử có lợi ích gì không?

s.t: Although they are often criticised, video games may have some educational benefits.
Many games require players to solve problems, plan ahead and make quick decisions.
Some schools even use strategy games to teach history and geography in a more engaging way.
Video games, if played in moderation, can therefore be more than just entertainment.

paragraphs.prompt: Ai chịu trách nhiệm bảo vệ nguồn nước?

s.t: Protecting clean water is largely the responsibility of governments.
Only governments have the power to make laws that stop factories from polluting rivers and lakes.
After strict rules were introduced in some European countries, rivers that were once dead are now home to fish again.
Individuals can help, but strong laws are likely to have the greatest effect.

paragraphs.topic: Giáo dục · điện thoại trong lớp
paragraphs.prompt: Có nên cấm điện thoại trong trường học?

s.t: Some people argue that mobile phones should be banned in schools completely.
They believe phones distract students and make it harder for teachers to control the class.
However, a complete ban may ignore the fact that phones can be useful learning tools.
Students can use them to look up new words, check facts or join online quizzes during lessons.
A better solution, therefore, may be to allow phones only for specific learning activities.

paragraphs.topic: Khoa học · thử nghiệm trên động vật
paragraphs.prompt: Có nên cấm thử nghiệm trên động vật?

s.t: It is often claimed that testing medicines on animals is necessary to protect human health.
Supporters say that new drugs must be tested on living bodies before they can be given to people safely.
Nevertheless, modern alternatives now make many animal tests unnecessary.
Scientists can increasingly use computer models and human cells grown in laboratories to check whether a drug is safe.
Animal testing should therefore be reduced as far as possible and replaced wherever alternatives exist.

paragraphs.prompt: Đại học có nên miễn học phí?

s.t: Opponents of free university education point out that it would be very expensive for taxpayers.
They argue that public money could be spent on more urgent needs, such as hospitals.
Admittedly, the cost is high; however, educated citizens tend to earn more and pay more tax later in life.
Countries such as Norway, where university is free, have some of the most skilled workforces in the world.
In the long term, free higher education may therefore be an investment rather than a cost.

paragraphs.topic: Công nghệ · trí tuệ nhân tạo
paragraphs.prompt: AI có lấy mất việc làm của con người?

s.t: Many people fear that artificial intelligence will take away millions of jobs.
It is true that machines can now do tasks such as answering customer questions or checking documents faster than humans.
However, history suggests that new technology also creates new types of work.
When computers became common, jobs such as web designer and data analyst appeared that had not existed before.
Rather than fearing AI, societies should focus on training workers for the jobs it will create.

paragraphs.topic: Xã hội · tiền cho thể thao
paragraphs.prompt: Chính phủ có nên chi nhiều tiền cho thể thao chuyên nghiệp?

s.t: Some believe that governments should spend large sums on professional sport because it brings national pride.
When a national team wins, people often feel happier and more united.
On the other hand, this money might be used more effectively to encourage ordinary people to exercise.
Building free sports facilities in local parks, for example, could benefit thousands of people rather than a few athletes.
Funding for grassroots sport should therefore be a higher priority than funding for elite teams.

paragraphs.prompt: Có nên hạn chế đi máy bay vì môi trường?

s.t: It could be argued that people should fly less in order to protect the environment.
Air travel produces a large amount of carbon dioxide per passenger compared with trains.
Even so, simply asking people to fly less is unlikely to work unless there are cheap alternatives.
In Europe, where fast trains connect many cities, more travellers now choose the train for short journeys.
Investing in high-speed rail may therefore be more effective than telling people not to fly.

paragraphs.topic: Giáo dục · giáo viên và máy tính
paragraphs.prompt: Máy tính có thể thay thế giáo viên?

s.t: Some people predict that computers will one day replace teachers.
Online courses can already deliver lessons to millions of learners at a very low cost.
Nonetheless, teachers do much more than deliver information.
They notice when a student is confused or unhappy and can change the lesson or offer support immediately.
For this reason, technology is more likely to support teachers than to replace them.

paragraphs.prompt: Thành phố có nên xây thêm nhà cao tầng?

s.t: Supporters of high-rise buildings argue that they are the best answer to housing shortages in crowded cities.
Tall buildings can house many families on a small piece of land.
However, if they are not well planned, high-rise areas may lack green space and community facilities.
Some tower blocks built quickly in the past are now known for social problems and poor living conditions.
High-rise housing can therefore be part of the solution, but only if it is carefully designed.

paragraphs.prompt: Mọi người có nên ăn ít thịt hơn?

s.t: Many argue that people should eat less meat for health and environmental reasons.
Producing meat uses a lot of land and water, and eating too much red meat is linked to some diseases.
That said, meat is an important source of protein and iron, especially for people with limited diets.
In poorer rural areas, a small amount of meat may be the most affordable way to get these nutrients.
A balanced approach, in which people reduce rather than give up meat, therefore seems most realistic.

paragraphs.topic: Xã hội · nghỉ thai sản cho bố
paragraphs.prompt: Có nên cho người bố nghỉ dài ngày khi có con?

s.t: Some employers claim that long paid leave for new fathers is too costly for businesses.
They worry that small companies cannot afford to pay staff who are not working.
Nevertheless, there is growing evidence that such leave brings long-term benefits.
In Sweden, where fathers share parental leave, mothers return to work more easily and children spend more time with both parents.
With some government support for small firms, paternity leave could therefore benefit families and the economy.

questions.q: Đoạn văn nói về lợi ích của việc học ngoại ngữ đối với công việc. Câu chủ đề nào tốt nhất?
o: Speaking a foreign language can greatly improve a person's job opportunities.
I started learning English when I was ten years old.
There are about 7,000 languages in the world.
English, Chinese and Japanese are popular languages.
questions.w: Câu chủ đề nêu đúng ý chính (ngoại ngữ → cơ hội việc làm). Các câu khác là thông tin bên lề hoặc chuyện cá nhân.

questions.q: Đoạn văn giải thích vì sao trẻ em nên chơi thể thao. Câu chủ đề nào tốt nhất?
o: Playing sports is important for children's physical and social development.
Football is the most popular sport in the world.
My brother plays basketball every Sunday.
Some sports are very expensive.
questions.w: Câu chủ đề phải trả lời trực tiếp câu hỏi "vì sao" và bao quát cả đoạn.

questions.q: Câu chủ đề nào quá rộng, KHÔNG phù hợp cho một đoạn văn?
o: Technology has changed everything in the world.
Online banking has made paying bills much faster.
Video calls help families who live far apart stay in touch.
Electric scooters are becoming popular in big cities.
questions.w: Câu chủ đề cần đủ hẹp để một đoạn (4–6 câu) chứng minh được. "Changed everything" quá rộng.

questions.q: Câu nào là câu chủ đề (không phải câu ví dụ)?
o: Working from home can reduce stress for many employees.
Last year, my aunt started working from home three days a week.
She no longer spends two hours in traffic jams.
Now she has time to cook breakfast for her children.
questions.w: Câu chủ đề nêu ý chung; ba câu còn lại là chi tiết / ví dụ cụ thể.

questions.q: Ý chính: "Social media helps small businesses reach more customers." Ví dụ nào phù hợp nhất?
o: A small bakery in Da Nang doubled its orders after posting photos of its cakes on Facebook.
Facebook was created in 2004 by Mark Zuckerberg.
Many teenagers spend hours on TikTok every day.
Some people think social media is a waste of time.
questions.w: Ví dụ phải chứng minh đúng ý chính: doanh nghiệp nhỏ + nhiều khách hơn nhờ mạng xã hội.

questions.q: Ý chính: "Living in a big city can be very expensive." Ví dụ nào phù hợp nhất?
o: In central Hanoi, renting a small flat can cost half of a young worker's salary.
Hanoi has a population of more than eight million people.
Big cities have many shopping centres and restaurants.
Traffic in big cities is often terrible.
questions.w: Ví dụ phải nói về chi phí đắt đỏ; các câu khác đúng nhưng không chứng minh ý này.

questions.q: Ý chính: "Regular exercise improves mental health." Ví dụ nào hỗ trợ tốt nhất?
o: Studies show that people who walk for thirty minutes a day feel less anxious.
Many gyms open at five o'clock in the morning.
Running shoes can be very expensive.
Some professional athletes earn millions of dollars.
questions.w: Chỉ câu đầu nối exercise với sức khỏe tinh thần (less anxious).

questions.q: Ý chính: "Public libraries are still useful today." Ví dụ nào phù hợp nhất?
o: Many students without a quiet room at home go to the library to study for exams.
The first public library in the world opened a long time ago.
Some libraries are very old and beautiful buildings.
People can read e-books on their phones.
questions.w: Ví dụ cần cho thấy thư viện vẫn có ích hiện nay.

questions.q: Đoạn văn: ý chính là "Cycling to work saves money", có giải thích và ví dụ. Câu kết đoạn nào phù hợp nhất?
o: Therefore, cycling is a practical choice for people who want to cut their transport costs.
Some bicycles are very expensive.
In conclusion, cars are dangerous.
I really like riding my bike at weekends.
questions.w: Câu kết đoạn nhắc lại ý chính và nối về đề (tiết kiệm tiền), không đưa ý mới.

questions.q: Câu nào là câu kết đoạn tốt cho đoạn văn về "lợi ích của việc đọc sách"?
o: In short, reading regularly benefits both our knowledge and our wellbeing.
Firstly, reading helps us learn new words.
For example, my sister reads two books a month.
Some people prefer watching films to reading.
questions.w: Câu kết đoạn tóm lại ý chính; "Firstly" mở ý, "For example" là ví dụ.

questions.q: Bạn muốn mở ý thứ hai trong bài. Câu nào phù hợp?
o: Another reason why people choose to live in cities is the quality of healthcare.
In conclusion, people live in cities.
For example, hospitals are good.
Although cities are big.
questions.w: "Another reason why…" là câu dẫn dắt mở ý tiếp theo, đầy đủ và rõ ràng.

questions.q: Câu nào nêu rõ quan điểm của người viết ngay đầu bài?
o: In my opinion, the advantages of online shopping clearly outweigh the disadvantages.
Online shopping is shopping on the internet.
Many people talk about online shopping.
Is online shopping good or bad?
questions.w: Mở bài nên nêu quan điểm rõ ràng (In my opinion / I believe that…), không chỉ định nghĩa hay đặt câu hỏi.

questions.q: Lập luận nào yếu nhất?
o: Everyone in my class likes video games, so all young people love them.
Many surveys show that a large number of teenagers play video games regularly.
Video games can improve reaction speed, according to some research.
Some young people prefer sports to video games.
questions.w: Lỗi khái quát hoá: từ một lớp học suy ra "tất cả người trẻ".

questions.q: Câu nào thiếu giải thích, chỉ khẳng định?
o: Uniforms are good because they are good.
Uniforms are good because students do not need to worry about what to wear.
Uniforms can reduce the pressure to buy expensive clothes.
Uniforms help students feel part of the school community.
questions.w: Lập luận vòng tròn: lấy kết luận làm lý do.

questions.q: Câu nào phù hợp hơn với văn viết học thuật?
o: Fast food may contribute to health problems such as obesity.
Fast food kills everyone who eats it.
Fast food is 100% bad.
Fast food is super terrible for you.
questions.w: Văn học thuật tránh nói tuyệt đối; "may contribute to" thận trọng và chính xác hơn.

questions.q: Câu nào nói giảm hợp lý nhất?
o: Young people tend to spend more time online than older people.
All young people are always online.
Young people never go outside.
Every teenager uses the internet 24 hours a day.
questions.w: "tend to" = có xu hướng — tránh khái quát tuyệt đối (all, always, never, every).

questions.q: Đề: "Some people think students should do part-time jobs." Câu chủ đề nào cho đoạn ủng hộ?
o: Doing a part-time job can help students develop useful skills for their future careers.
I have never had a part-time job.
Part-time jobs are jobs that are not full-time.
Some students are very busy.
questions.w: Câu chủ đề nêu một lý do ủng hộ cụ thể (kỹ năng cho sự nghiệp).

questions.q: Ý chính: "Tourism can damage the environment." Ví dụ nào phù hợp nhất?
o: On some popular beaches, plastic bottles left by tourists harm sea turtles and fish.
Many tourists like taking photos.
Tourism is a big industry in Thailand.
Hotels near the beach are expensive.
questions.w: Ví dụ chứng minh tác hại môi trường cụ thể.

questions.q: Bạn muốn đưa một ví dụ. Câu dẫn dắt nào đúng?
o: A good example of this is Singapore, which has very clean streets.
Such as Singapore has clean streets.
For example of Singapore, the streets are clean.
Singapore, for example of this, is clean.
questions.w: "A good example of this is…" / "For example, …" là cách đưa ví dụ đúng; such as không đứng đầu câu.

questions.q: Câu nào nối lại về đề bài "Should children learn to cook at school?" tốt nhất?
o: For these reasons, cooking lessons should be part of the school curriculum.
Cooking is fun.
My mother is a very good cook.
Many restaurants are open late at night.
questions.w: Câu kết nối về đề: trả lời "should" bằng một khuyến nghị rõ ràng.

questions.q: Ví dụ nào KHÔNG liên quan đến ý "Learning English opens up job opportunities"?
o: English is the official language of many countries, and the UK has a famous royal family.
Many international companies in Vietnam require English for well-paid positions.
Tour guides who speak English can work with more customers.
Hotel staff with good English are often promoted faster.
questions.w: Ví dụ không liên quan (hoàng gia Anh) làm đoạn văn lạc đề.

questions.q: Câu nào là cách nói thận trọng, phù hợp với IELTS Writing?
o: It could be argued that homework puts too much pressure on young children.
Homework definitely destroys every child's life.
Everybody knows homework is useless.
Homework is always 100% bad.
questions.w: "It could be argued that…" giới thiệu một quan điểm một cách thận trọng.

questions.q: Từ nào làm câu "Online learning ___ be less effective for young children." thận trọng hơn?
o: may
will always
must definitely
surely will
questions.w: may / might / can = có thể — tránh khẳng định tuyệt đối.

questions.q: Câu nào phù hợp nhất cho bài viết học thuật?
o: Many experts believe that sugar is one of the main causes of obesity.
Sugar is the only cause of obesity.
Sugar makes everyone fat.
I think sugar is bad because I don't like it.
questions.w: Dựa vào ý kiến chuyên gia và tránh nói tuyệt đối (the only, everyone).

questions.q: Câu nào dùng "tend to" đúng và hợp lý?
o: People in cities tend to have less contact with their neighbours.
People in cities tend having less contact with their neighbours.
People in cities are tend to have less contact.
People in cities tends to have less contact.
questions.w: tend to + V nguyên mẫu, chia theo chủ ngữ (people tend to).

questions.q: Chọn từ phù hợp: "There is ___ evidence that regular exercise reduces stress."
o: strong
absolute
complete
questions.w: Văn học thuật dùng strong / growing / some evidence, tránh "absolute / 100%".

questions.q: Lập luận nào có lỗi "nguyên nhân sai"?
o: I wore my lucky shirt and passed the exam, so the shirt helped me pass.
I studied every day for three months, so I passed the exam.
Because I practised many tests, I knew the format well.
I passed because I managed my time carefully.
questions.w: Hai việc xảy ra cùng lúc không có nghĩa là cái này gây ra cái kia.

questions.q: Câu nào đưa ra lý do yếu nhất cho ý "Students should wear uniforms"?
o: Uniforms should be worn because they have always been worn.
Uniforms reduce the pressure to wear expensive brands.
Uniforms make it easier to recognise students on school trips.
Uniforms save parents time in the morning.
questions.w: "Vì xưa nay vẫn thế" không phải lý do thuyết phục.

questions.q: Câu nào chỉ dựa vào cảm xúc, không có lý lẽ?
o: Zoos are terrible and anyone who visits them is a bad person.
Some zoos keep animals in cages that are far too small.
Well-run zoos can help protect endangered species.
Many zoos now educate visitors about wildlife.
questions.w: Công kích người khác và dùng cảm xúc thay cho lý lẽ là lập luận yếu.

questions.q: Ví dụ nào yếu nhất để chứng minh "Public transport is unreliable"?
o: My friend once waited ten minutes for a bus.
According to a city report, 30% of buses arrived more than fifteen minutes late last year.
Commuters' complaints about delays have doubled in two years.
Several train lines were cancelled every week during the rainy season.
questions.w: Một trải nghiệm cá nhân nhỏ không đủ chứng minh một kết luận chung.

questions.q: Câu chủ đề nào thận trọng và rõ ràng nhất?
o: Working from home may improve the work-life balance of many employees.
Working from home is the best thing ever.
Working from home has many things.
Everybody should work from home forever.
questions.w: Câu chủ đề tốt: một ý rõ ràng, nói giảm hợp lý (may, many).

questions.q: Ý chính: "Social media may make teenagers feel worse about themselves." Ví dụ nào có sức thuyết phục nhất?
o: A survey of 1,000 teenagers found that many felt unhappy after comparing their lives with others' photos online.
My cousin uses Instagram every day.
Social media companies earn money from advertising.
Some teenagers post photos of their food.
questions.w: Số liệu khảo sát liên quan trực tiếp mạnh hơn chuyện cá nhân hay thông tin bên lề.

questions.q: Ý chính: "Higher taxes on sugary drinks may improve public health." Ví dụ nào phù hợp nhất?
o: After Mexico introduced a tax on sugary drinks, people bought fewer of them.
Coca-Cola is sold in more than 200 countries.
Sugary drinks are very sweet.
Some people prefer coffee to soft drinks.
questions.w: Ví dụ cho thấy chính sách thuế dẫn tới kết quả tốt.

questions.q: Câu nào giới thiệu quan điểm của người khác một cách khách quan?
o: Some people argue that university education should be free for everyone.
People wrongly say that university should be free.
Stupid people think university should be free.
University should be free, I am sure everybody agrees.
questions.w: "Some people argue that…" nêu quan điểm khác một cách trung lập.

questions.q: Câu nào chuyển sang ý đối lập trong bài "Discuss both views"?
o: On the other hand, others believe that students should pay for their own studies.
In addition, students should pay for their studies.
For example, students should pay.
Therefore, students should pay for their studies.
questions.w: Chuyển sang quan điểm thứ hai → On the other hand, others believe…

questions.q: Câu kết đoạn nào phù hợp nhất cho đoạn về tác hại của việc thức khuya?
o: Getting enough sleep is therefore essential for both students' health and their results.
Some people go to bed at nine o'clock.
Firstly, sleep is important.
Coffee contains caffeine.
questions.w: Câu kết đoạn tóm lại ý và nối về đề, không mở ý mới.

questions.q: Câu nào KHÔNG nên đặt cuối một đoạn thân bài?
o: Another important factor is the cost of housing.
This shows that cities need better public transport.
For these reasons, the policy is likely to succeed.
Clearly, this approach has more benefits than drawbacks.
questions.w: "Another important factor…" mở ý mới, nên đặt đầu đoạn tiếp theo.

questions.q: Cụm nào làm câu "This policy ___ reduce traffic" thận trọng nhất mà vẫn rõ ý?
o: is likely to
will 100%
must certainly
will definitely always
questions.w: "is likely to" = nhiều khả năng sẽ.

questions.q: Câu nào là khái quát hoá quá mức?
o: All old people dislike modern technology.
Some older people find modern technology difficult to use.
Many older people now use smartphones to talk to their families.
Older people may need more time to learn new apps.
questions.w: "All" khái quát toàn bộ một nhóm người là lỗi lập luận.

questions.q: Đề: "Is it better to live alone or with family?" Câu chủ đề nào cho đoạn ủng hộ sống cùng gia đình?
o: Living with family can provide emotional support during difficult times.
Families are groups of people.
I have three sisters and one brother.
Rent is high in many cities.
questions.w: Câu chủ đề nêu một lý do rõ ràng ủng hộ quan điểm.

questions.q: Ý chính: "Learning to play an instrument may improve children's concentration." Ví dụ nào phù hợp nhất?
o: Children who practise the piano daily often have to focus on one task for a long time.
Pianos are very heavy and expensive.
Mozart was a famous composer.
Some people prefer listening to music to playing it.
questions.w: Ví dụ cho thấy mối liên hệ giữa học nhạc và khả năng tập trung.

questions.q: Câu nào nêu ý kiến trái chiều một cách khách quan trước khi phản bác?
o: It is often claimed that online friendships are less meaningful than real ones.
Online friendships are obviously fake.
Only foolish people make friends online.
Online friends are the best friends, everyone agrees.
questions.w: "It is often claimed that…" trình bày quan điểm đối lập trung lập, chuẩn bị cho phần phản bác.

questions.q: Sau câu "Some people say that homework is unnecessary.", câu phản bác nào tốt nhất?
o: However, regular homework can help students remember what they have learned in class.
However, homework is homework.
However, these people are wrong and silly.
However, I don't like homework either.
questions.w: Phản bác bằng một lý lẽ cụ thể, không công kích hay lặp lại.

questions.q: Câu nào dùng "Admittedly" đúng cách (nhượng bộ rồi phản bác)?
o: Admittedly, electric cars are expensive; however, they are cheaper to run over time.
Admittedly, electric cars are cheaper to run and also cheaper to buy.
Admittedly, I love electric cars.
Admittedly, firstly, electric cars are good.
questions.w: Admittedly thừa nhận một điểm của phía kia, sau đó However đưa ra phản bác.

questions.q: Từ nào điền vào chỗ trống phù hợp nhất? "___ it is true that tourism creates jobs, it can also damage local culture."
o: While
Despite
Because
Moreover
questions.w: While (= Although) + mệnh đề: nhượng bộ rồi nêu mặt trái.

questions.q: Câu nào là phản bác hiệu quả nhất cho ý "Video games make children violent"?
o: However, most research has found no clear link between playing games and violent behaviour.
However, video games are fun.
However, I have played games for years.
However, games are expensive.
questions.w: Phản bác bằng bằng chứng liên quan trực tiếp đến luận điểm.

questions.q: Câu nào mở đoạn "phía bên kia" trong bài thảo luận hai quan điểm?
o: On the other hand, there are strong arguments against this view.
In conclusion, this view is right.
For example, this view is popular.
Firstly, I agree with this view.
questions.w: "On the other hand, there are strong arguments against…" chuyển sang phía đối lập.

questions.q: Câu mở bài nào phù hợp cho dạng "To what extent do you agree?"
o: I partly agree that cities should ban cars, but I believe a complete ban would be unrealistic.
Cars are vehicles with four wheels.
This essay will talk about cars.
Do you like cars? I do.
questions.w: Mở bài nêu rõ mức độ đồng ý và hướng lập luận.

questions.q: Câu nào giới thiệu kết luận tốt nhất?
o: In conclusion, although online learning has some drawbacks, its flexibility makes it a valuable option.
In conclusion, there is one more advantage I forgot to mention.
In conclusion, firstly, online learning is good.
In conclusion, the end.
questions.w: Kết luận tóm tắt quan điểm, có thể nhắc cả hai mặt, không đưa ý mới.

questions.q: Lập luận nào là "ngụy biện trượt dốc" (cho rằng một bước nhỏ chắc chắn dẫn tới thảm họa)?
o: If we allow students to use phones in class, soon they will stop learning completely and fail all their exams.
Allowing phones for some activities may distract a few students.
Phones can help students look up information quickly.
Teachers need clear rules about phone use.
questions.w: Kéo một bước nhỏ thành chuỗi hậu quả cực đoan mà không có bằng chứng.

questions.q: Lập luận nào chỉ đưa ra hai lựa chọn, bỏ qua các khả năng khác?
o: Either we stop all car use today, or our cities will be destroyed.
Reducing car use could improve air quality.
Better buses may encourage people to drive less.
Some cities have reduced traffic with congestion charges.
questions.w: "Either … or …" cực đoan, bỏ qua giải pháp trung gian.

questions.q: Câu nào cân bằng và thận trọng nhất?
o: While social media has clear benefits, it may also have negative effects on young people's sleep.
Social media is completely evil.
Social media has no problems at all.
Social media will destroy the next generation.
questions.w: Thừa nhận cả hai mặt, dùng "may" — phù hợp văn học thuật.

questions.q: Câu kết đoạn nào phù hợp sau khi đã nêu ý trái chiều và phản bác?
o: On balance, the benefits of the scheme appear to outweigh its costs.
Some people think the scheme is expensive.
Another point is that the scheme is new.
For example, the scheme started last year.
questions.w: "On balance, … outweigh …" cân nhắc hai mặt rồi đưa kết luận.

questions.q: Câu nào nhượng bộ (thừa nhận phía kia có lý một phần)?
o: It is true that living in the countryside can be lonely for young people.
Living in the countryside is perfect in every way.
Nobody should ever live in a city.
The countryside has trees.
questions.w: "It is true that…" thừa nhận một điểm hợp lý của phía kia.

questions.q: Sau câu nhượng bộ "Admittedly, school uniforms can be expensive.", câu nào tiếp theo hợp lý nhất?
o: However, they may still save families money because children need fewer everyday clothes.
Moreover, uniforms are expensive.
For example, uniforms cost money.
In conclusion, uniforms are expensive.
questions.w: Sau nhượng bộ phải là phản bác (However…), không phải thêm ý cùng chiều.

questions.q: Ý phản bác: "Free public transport may not reduce traffic." Ví dụ nào phù hợp nhất?
o: In one city that made buses free, car traffic hardly changed because the buses were still slow and crowded.
Buses are usually painted in bright colours.
Many people like taking taxis.
Some cities have underground trains.
questions.w: Ví dụ chứng minh trực tiếp cho ý phản bác.

questions.q: Đề: "Should the government pay for people's healthcare?" Câu chủ đề nào cho đoạn trình bày ý kiến trái chiều?
o: Critics argue that free healthcare could lead to very high taxes.
Healthcare is very important.
My uncle is a doctor.
Hospitals are often crowded.
questions.w: Đoạn trái chiều mở bằng quan điểm của "critics", nêu lý do cụ thể.

questions.q: Cách viết nào phù hợp hơn: "Rich countries ___ help poorer countries."
o: should arguably
must 100%
have to definitely always
always must
questions.w: "arguably" = có thể lập luận rằng — giữ quan điểm nhưng mềm hơn.

questions.q: Câu nào dẫn vào ý quan trọng nhất?
o: The most important reason, however, is that education gives people more choices in life.
The most important reason is reason number three.
Education is education.
And then there is also another thing.
questions.w: Câu dẫn dắt nhấn mạnh rõ (The most important reason…) và nêu luôn nội dung.

questions.q: Câu nào là lập luận dựa vào số đông (ai cũng làm thì đúng)?
o: Everyone uses plastic bags, so they cannot be harmful.
Plastic bags take hundreds of years to break down.
Some countries have banned plastic bags.
Paper bags can be recycled more easily.
questions.w: Nhiều người làm không chứng minh việc đó vô hại.

questions.q: Câu nào là câu kết đoạn KHÔNG tốt vì đưa ý mới?
o: In addition, governments should also lower the price of electricity.
Overall, these measures could make cities cleaner.
For these reasons, cycling deserves more support.
This shows how important public parks are.
questions.w: Câu kết đoạn không nên mở thêm ý mới.
